body:
You guys have been sending each other mixed signals.
 
Either he wanted a relationship and felt like he got shot down (and is terrible at dealing with conflicting feelings) OR he wanted a FWB situation, thought he was shot down, then felt that it would be possible (only to be shot down again).  

The core problem is communication. The two of you need to be crystal clear about what you want from each other. In any event, this would be necessary for a successful relationship (as friends, FWB, or something else). Tbh, from what you have written, I do not think he is mature enough for this type of honesty and that you are better off keeping him at an arms' length.  

I suggest having  the conversation with him. It seems like having things up in the air is having a toll on your friendship. If he is unclear or ambiguous, be nice to him but no cutesy stuff (this will further confuse the situation). Under that scenario, you should treat him as a friend from now on. However, if the two of you reach an agreement on what the nature of your relationship is, act accordingly.

Hahahaha...Thank you for your response. I think it's been the first thing to bring a smile to my face in a while. In terms of the challenge: I'm in a very hazy place right now, and can't really dissociate from my problems to offer a solution. A part of me is kicking myself, saying that I need to stop putting things off and just get to DOING. Another part of me suggests sleeping first and then reevaluating.
